Karthik — flagged. For US suppliers we typically require:

- W-9 (received)
- Bank account verification (voided check or bank letter) — your bank details spreadsheet is a start but we need proof of account ownership
- State withholding exemption certificate if billing address is in a different state than the legal entity (rare for international entities)
- Certificate of Insurance (if they will perform on-site work) — likely not applicable here.
